DK25.6 is a specific medical diagnosis code representing a chronic or unspecified gastric ulcer accompanied by both hemorrhage and perforation. Within the Danish healthcare system, this code plays a critical role in clinical quality monitoring, specifically for patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. 

The code is utilized as part of a comprehensive quality indicator designed to measure the incidence of severe bleeding events in the [[atrieflimren]] patient population [^src1]. Because patients with this condition are frequently prescribed anticoagulant medications, tracking severe bleeding complications is a vital safety and quality metric. DK25.6 is grouped within a broader category of gastrointestinal bleeding codes (ranging from [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] to [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]], as well as [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] to [[dk92-2|DK92.2]]) that collectively capture various digestive tract hemorrhages [^src1]. 

This tracking methodology is detailed in the annual reports from the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), which standardizes data collection across Danish regions to evaluate the diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up care of cardiovascular patients [^src1] [^src2]. Alongside gastrointestinal codes, the severe bleeding indicator also incorporates codes for intracranial bleeding (such as [[di60|DI60]] through [[ds066|DS066]]) and urinary or respiratory tract bleeding (including [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) to ensure a holistic view of bleeding risks associated with [[atrieflimren]] treatments [^src1].
